query:
SELECT 
  s.id,
  s.companyName,
  u.email as linkedUserEmail,
  s.contactEmail,
  CASE WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(u.email, '@', -1) != SUBSTRING_INDEX(s.contactEmail, '@', -1) THEN 'MISMATCH' ELSE 'OK' END as domainCheck
FROM sponsors s
LEFT JOIN users u ON s.userId = u.id
WHERE s.companyName NOT IN ('AI Limited','Amberjack','Appcast','Bright Apply','Elevate Assess','hackajob','Happydance Careers Websites','Harver','inploi','JobSync','Little Moment','Maki People','NexaTalent Solutions Ltd','PerchPeek','Poetry')
ORDER BY s.companyName;
